title: Results table
subject: Science
source: Written for science/y7 lessons 44, 46 (Results table (portal worksheet))
intro: Lesson 44: Friction and drag. A practical to do at home with an adult nearby. Read it all first.

practical.aim: To find out which surface gives the most friction
equipment: A tray or board as a ramp
safety: An adult knows what you are doing and is nearby
Clear a space and tidy up afterwards; wash your hands
method: Put the ramp on the floor; keep fingers clear
Put the shoe at the top of the flat ramp
Lift one end slowly until the shoe slides
Measure the height of the end
Repeat with each surface covering the ramp
The higher the ramp, the more friction

questions.q: Big question: would life be easier with no friction?
questions.a: No: we could not walk, grip or stop.
